text:
Kai: heads-up — found a validation gap when using per-route header transform templates in the Console. pasted a minimal example and it only fails at deploy.

Kai: here's the snippet I pasted into the YAML editor:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: user-emails
    match:
      path: /users/:id/emails
    headers:
      add:
        X-User: "{{request.user.id}}"
      transform:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{secrets.api_key}}"
```

Maria: hmm are we mixing templating contexts for `add` vs `transform`? client lint didn't flag anything.

Sam: I reproduced. server-side deploy validator throws: `template: undefined variable \"secrets\"`. staging pipeline rejects the route.

lint-bot: ERROR route[user-emails] header.transform.Authorization -> templating variable 'secrets' is not in allowed context. See docs: https://internal.docs/routing/templating

Olivia: UX problem: Console shows green "Valid YAML" after save but the deploy fails later. Users think it's safe. we should surface this earlier. :grimacing: 

Kai: repro steps: paste YAML -> Save -> Console says saved -> Start rollout -> deploy rejects with template error. Happened on staging-3 and prod-preview.

Maria: we merged allowed-template-context into the schema last month but it's optional at authoring time. the client linter only runs JSON schema validation, not the runtime template context whitelist.

qa-bot: adding test: `routing-specs::test_header_template_context_validation` to catch missing context failures in CI.

Sam: proposal: client linter should run the same schema + context whitelist used by runtime. if a template references an illegal context, show inline warning and block rollout unless forced.

Olivia: and add a "Preview template resolution" button in Console that runs server-side safe evaluation (sandbox with redacted secrets) and lists missing keys. helps debug these errors before starting a rollout.

Kai: agree. i'll draft a small PR: add context-check step to client linter + a warning banner on save. i'll include unit tests that mirror runtime's allowed-keys. tagging @Maria for review. :eyes:

Maria: ack, will review tomorrow morning. thanks for catching this!
